heart.

text_block_list.text:
"'It was close; next time,
victory will be ours.'
Perhaps thinking of it that way is
healthier."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: My thanks for the sound counsel, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:

Regretting it now will accomplish nothing.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:

failure,
perhaps we should formulate a strategy.

delay.
I would very much like to hear your perspective
as well.
